des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory. You can select one of the MCP services below, or add your own new MCP service.
We keep testing and adding useful MCP services here; everyone is welcome to contribute.
Remember to delete the comment lines. The des property is for documentation only and is not parsed.
The des and link properties are only for explaining how to install and to show the original links for reference; they are not required.
Currently supports three transport modes: stdio (standard input/output), sse (Server-Sent Events), streamable-http (streaming HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Uses the Streamable HTTP transport mode, suitable for production web deployments
